method.retrieval_pool: same 128 different-family MIDI-2 alternatives as issue161
method.selection: two seed-161 triplets each for 24 evenly spaced preset families; query and retrieval candidates from unchanged issue161 choices

comparison_to_stored_original.comparison_type: paired full-cohort point estimates; intervals shown separately by condition

basic_pitch_trunk.tap: post-BN/ReLU contour_conv1; average 3 bins per semitone, flatten 8 channels × 88 pitches

cir_ast.tap: mean of final CLS and distillation tokens

difficult_preset_stratum.reason: Existing source-family metadata maps each of the 129 presets to a singleton family and contains no independent difficulty label; no model-specific distance or retrieval score was used to select a subset.

input_normalization.out_of_range_source_samples: reported; common target guarantees no normalized peak exceeds 0.95
input_normalization.target_selection: 0.95 divided by maximum cohort peak/active-RMS ratio, minus a 1e-6 relative margin
input_normalization.zero_extension: windows at every integer start overlapping first through last nonzero sample

statistics.bootstrap_combination_sampling: Monte Carlo estimate of the exhaustive 2x2 statistic; preset and MIDI pairs are sampled from their resampled clusters conditioned on distinct original identities, yielding multiplicity-product pair weights; full-cohort point summaries are exhaustive
statistics.bootstrap_method: crossed preset-family × MIDI-performance cluster bootstrap; anchored distance pairs use distinct original identities sampled in proportion to bootstrap multiplicity products; variance shares use the full crossed resampled grid; identical cluster draws and sampled pair positions across arms
statistics.confidence_interval: percentile 95% interval over crossed cluster resamples; intervals do not treat anchor observations as independent
statistics.paired_effect_estimator: difference between observed exhaustive full-cohort point estimates; paired bootstrap distribution supplies the confidence interval only
statistics.preset_dominant_rule: different-preset same-MIDI distance exceeds same-preset different-MIDI distance by more than tie tolerance
statistics.ratio_rule: undefined if different-preset same-MIDI cosine distance is at or below the near-zero tolerance

normalization.out_of_range_source_samples: reported; common target guarantees no normalized peak exceeds 0.95
normalization.target_selection: 0.95 divided by maximum cohort peak/active-RMS ratio, minus a 1e-6 relative margin
normalization.zero_extension: windows at every integer start overlapping first through last nonzero sample

acoustic_contract.active_rms: 20 ms sliding mean-square windows, zero extension, relative -40 dB gate
acoustic_contract.alignment: sample zero; exact full-clip frame match; no shift, trim, or padding
acoustic_contract.matching: scale candidate B3 by active_rms(A3)/active_rms(B3) before spectral comparison
acoustic_contract.scoring_window: full saved stereo WAV including renderer tail

design.bootstrap: paired crossed resamples of 129 preset families and 12 triplets
input_conditions: active-RMS normalized waveform before encoder preprocessing
design.oracle: recomputed separately under each acoustic score matrix
design.random_alternative: same deterministic seed-161 alternative IDs under both score matrices
